Demo copy — welcome your customers and explain what this page covers.
Answers below are placeholders for your own policies.

settings.contact_text: Send us a message and we'll get back to you.

settings.heading: Shipping & returns
settings.text: Common questions about delivery, returns and exchanges.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Demo answer — list the countries you ship to and link to your shipping policy.

settings.question: When will my order ship?
settings.answer: Demo answer — describe your usual handling time and how customers are notified.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: Demo answer — summarise the return window and link to the full refund policy.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Demo answer — give typical delivery times per region.

settings.heading: Orders
settings.text: Common questions about placing and changing orders.

settings.question: How do I place an order?
settings.answer: Demo answer — add products to the cart and check out; payment is handled by Shopify.

settings.question: How do I know my order is confirmed?
settings.answer: Demo answer — customers receive an order confirmation email after checkout.

settings.question: Can I change the shipping address after ordering?
settings.answer: Demo answer — explain how quickly customers should contact you.

settings.question: Can I change the billing address after ordering?
settings.answer: Demo answer — explain what you can and cannot change after checkout.

settings.question: Which size or model should I choose?
settings.answer: Demo answer — link to a size guide or comparison page.

settings.question: Where can I find care instructions?
settings.answer: Demo answer — point to the product page tabs or a care guide.

settings.question: Do you offer gift cards?
settings.answer: Demo answer — say whether gift cards are available and where to buy them.

settings.heading: Customer service
settings.text: Real people answer within one business day.
